summary: Independent P0 verification of v56 timeout classification + hard-cutover pass. Ran main-agent-cited suites (test_iter198_authority_cutover.py 9, test_iter195_execution_invariants.py 10, test_iter193_v55_batch.py 23) = 42/42 green. Authored 2 new suites (test_iter124_p0_verification.py 6 tests, test_iter124_e2e_intent_wiring.py 2 tests) proving: (a) TimeoutError in run_once → status 'unknown', executor NEVER re-runs on retry (duplicate+in_flight=True), reconcile with open trade → 'reconciled', with failed trade → 'failed_confirmed'; (b) ValueError / PermissionError / ConnectionRefusedError / PreDispatchError → 'rejected'; (c) real POST /api/accounts/{id}/test-trade flow persists trade with execution_intent_id set, and the referenced intent history contains created→validated→authorized→submitted; (d) GET /api/authority + /api/execution/intents + /api/execution/intents/stats return 200 for admin. Ran regression suites test_iter86_test_trade.py 6/6, test_iter191_v53_batch.py + test_iter185_pamm_m1.py 15/15 (PAMM emergency-stop verified flatten & sweep retry both green). Frontend smoke: admin login on stoic-trading-bot.preview.emergentagent.com works, dashboard renders with data-testid='authority-strip' present. Total: 71/71 tests passed. No blocking issues found.

issues: 4 x 401 console errors on initial load — background poller fetches before session cookie fully seated; pre-existing, non-blocking, noted in previous iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: execution_intents.request_never_left() classifier is correctly conservative: unknown exception types default to False (POST_DISPATCH → UNKNOWN, never resent). Good defensive default.
run_once() merges result.error into any partial result written by the executor (e.g. trade_id stashed before response was lost). Good — preserves broker-truth pointer for reconcile.
MT5BridgeEngine.execute is a real shim: `assert 'submit_intent' in inspect.getsource(...)` passes; execute_authorized(intent=...) exists. Cutover is source-level provable.

Pre-dispatch refusals (validation / authority / engine gates) correctly RELEASE the dedupe_key ($unset), verified via `'dedupe_key' not in doc` assertions in 3 places. From dispatch onward at-most-once is strict.

Only minor observation: reconcile_unknown_intents relies on result.trade_id being present — if an executor times out BEFORE stashing trade_id, the intent stays UNKNOWN awaiting operator (this is the correct safe behaviour and is already alerted via pamm_notifications after alert_after_sec).
